Because<WH0834> thou obeyedst<WH08085><WTH8804> not the voice<WH06963> of the LORD<WH03068>, nor executedst<WH06213><WTH8804> his fierce<WH02740> wrath<WH0639> upon Amalek<WH06002>, therefore hath the LORD<WH03068> done<WH06213><WTH8804> this thing<WH01697> unto thee this day<WH03117>.

Then Saul<WH07586> fell<WH05307><WTH8799> straightway<WH04116><WTH8762> all<WH04393> along<WH06967> on the earth<WH0776>, and was sore<WH03966> afraid<WH03372><WTH8799>, because of the words<WH01697> of Samuel<WH08050>: and there was no strength<WH03581> in him; for he had eaten<WH0398><WTH8804> no bread<WH03899> all the day<WH03117>, nor all the night<WH03915>. <RF>fell...: Heb. made haste, and fell with the fulness of his stature<Rf>
